themes.evidence: We conduct our business consistent with all applicable laws and are honest in our dealings with customers, employees, shareholders, partners, suppliers, competitors and the community.
We pursue pharmaceutical innovation, provide high quality products and strive to deliver superior business results.
Respect for people includes our concern for all people who touch or are touched by our company: customers, employees, shareholders, partners, suppliers and communities.

linguistic_shift: The values are restated but the wording is consistent with prior years.
